2317-6763-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
2317-6763-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

1479-1659-2841-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-1659-2841-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Seed the Land trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

261-1895-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Suture Priest trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
261-1895-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1733-2103-7722.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Nephalia Smuggler.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

618-4456-7089-7494.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Fire Lord Azula and Hematite Talisman trigger.
Resolve the Fire Lord Azula trigger, copying Seething Song.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hematite Talisman trigger, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve the original Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

4863-4872-5144.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Revolutionist and exiling Ephemerate.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1879-2463-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-2463-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-4871-5496-5998-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Repeat.

1456-2757-3459-5078.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Battered Golem, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

321-399-2146-2475-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

2438-5220-6578-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
2438-5220-6578-6900.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

2316-4050-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-4050-6753.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

1263-2060-2292-6701.description:
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1263-2060-2292-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

942-2523-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Samwise the Stouthearted.
When Samwise the Stouthearted dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Samwise the Stouthearted that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Samwise the Stouthearted token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Samwise the Stouthearted token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-3719-5326-5361.notablePrerequisites: Auton Soldier has a power of at least 2.
2713-3719-5326-5361.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Auton Soldier and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Auton Soldier to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Auton Soldier by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-2034-2857.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
1636-2034-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1336-1909-4486.notablePrerequisites: Heronblade Elite does not have summoning sickness. Heronblade Elite has power 2 or greater who has at least a +1/+0 boost from secondary effects.
1336-1909-4486.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat.
1336-1909-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

290-1978-3007.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
290-1978-3007.description:
Animate Dreamstone Hedron using Toymaker.
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat from step 2.

147-3645-5256.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1722-2034-3583-4476.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-4476.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1086-2034-2308.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1086-2034-2308.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
The Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Anointer Priest.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-1368-2034-4408.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1283-1368-2034-4408.description:
Cast Venture Deeper from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill four cards and then exiling Venture Deeper.
Cast Merfolk Secretkeeper from exile by paying {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Merfolk Secretkeeper, adding {2}.
Repeat.

2111-2646-3466.notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2111-2646-3466.description:
Cast Wingrattle Scarecrow by paying {3}.
Wingrattle Scarecrow enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Reaper King triggers, destroying Wingrattle Scarecrow.
Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Repeat from step 3.

586-2771-3069-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {U} and exiling it to Void Maw.
Activate Void Maw by returning Priest of Gix to your graveyard, giving Void Maw +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Dreams of the Dead for {1}{U}, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix ETBs, add {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

364-1987-3227-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.
